description: Express.js route definitions for authentication endpoints including health check, signup, login, and password reset, with JWT token issuance and tenant-based user management.

methods.name: router.get('/health')
methods.description: Health check endpoint for tenant salt configuration status.

methods.name: router.post('/signup')
methods.description: Endpoint to create or update a user with hashed password, auto-generating tenant salt if needed.

methods.name: router.post('/login')
methods.description: Authenticate user, issue JWT token, and handle migration from legacy hashes.

methods.name: router.post('/reset-password')
methods.description: Reset user password with v2 hashing scheme, generating tenant salt if missing.
